module AnswerSizeTest.``example``

open NUnit.Framework

// Saved as .txt rather than .fs. Here the extension is not what keeps this
// file out: cyber-dojo.sh names Hiker.fs and HikerTest.fs on the compiler
// command line, so renaming this to .fs would leave it just as unread. The
// test below is one that would fail, so a green says it really did not run.
[<Test>]
let ``the answer is three digits long.`` () =
   Assert.That((string Hiker.answer).Length, Is.EqualTo(3))
